core_obligations: Reduce to stalks (proof lines 3841-3844): since the source site has enough points, a complex is K-flat exactly when its pullbacks to the points are K-flat complexes of modules over the local rings.
Apply the hypothesis (proof lines 3844-3846): the pullback of a K-flat complex to a point is computed by tensoring with a flat module, so it is again K-flat, and the criterion gives the conclusion.
proof_roadmap: Test K-flatness on the points of the site.
Compute the pullback at a point as a tensor product with a flat module.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a morphism of ringed topoi whose source has enough points, the pullback of a K-flat complex is K-flat (statement lines 3833-3839). The proof reduces the assertion to the points of the site, where K-flatness is tested by the companion criterion (proof lines 3841-3844), and then observes that pulling back to a point is tensoring with a flat module, which preserves K-flatness (proof lines 3844-3846). The non-formal content is the reduction to points. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one computation at a point.
